items.title: Fake news game confers psychological resistance against online misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: In a novel attempt to address this issue, we designed a psychological intervention in the form of an online browser game. The game draws on an inoculation metaphor, where preemptively exposing, warning, and familiarising people with the strategies used in the production of fake news helps confer cognitive immunity when exposed to real misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: We conducted a large-scale evaluation of the game with N = 15,000 participants in a pre-post gameplay design.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico com um jogo de inoculação (Bad News) para combater a desinformação, utilizando um desenho pré-pós intervenção, o que está alinhado com os critérios do pedido. O achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Prebunking interventions based on the psychological theory of “inoculation” can reduce susceptibility to misinformation across cultures

judge.evidence_topic: This study finds that the online “fake news” game, Bad News, can confer psychological resistance against common online misinformation strategies (e.g., conspiracy theories, manipulating emotions, political polarization) across different cultures (Sweden, German, Poland, and Greece).
judge.evidence_empirical: This study finds that the online “fake news” game, Bad News, can confer psychological resistance against common online misinformation strategies...
judge.reason: O artigo trata de um jogo de inoculação (Bad News), atendendo ao tema. O estudo é empírico. O resumo não descreve o método, impossibilitando a verificação do método informado. O achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Game-based inoculation versus graphic-based inoculation to combat misinformation: a randomized controlled trial

judge.evidence_topic: This study employed inoculation theory and developed an interactive game to help the public counter misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: A total of 180 Chinese participants were randomly assigned to game-based inoculation, graphic-based inoculation, and control groups.
judge.reason: O estudo é um ensaio controlado randomizado que avalia um jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão e exclusão. Os dados extraídos refletem fielmente o resumo.

items.title: Gamified Inoculation Against Misinformation in India: A Randomized Control Trial

judge.evidence_topic: We report the results of a game-based intervention against misinformation in India. The game is based on the mechanism of psychological inoculation
judge.evidence_empirical: We report the results of a game-based intervention against misinformation in India... the present study conducted in north India (n = 757)
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um ensaio controlado randomizado (RCT) de uma intervenção baseada em jogo para inoculação contra desinformação, o que se alinha perfeitamente com os critérios de inclusão. O achado principal relatado pelos dados extraídos é uma tradução direta e precisa do que está escrito no resumo.

items.title: Long-term effectiveness of inoculation against misinformation: Three longitudinal experiments

judge.evidence_topic: This study investigates the long-term effectiveness of active psychological inoculation as a means to build resistance against misinformation. Using 3 longitudinal experiments (2 preregistered), we tested the effectiveness of Bad News
judge.evidence_empirical: In 3 experiments (NExp1 = 151, NExp2 = 194, NExp3 = 170), participants played either Bad News (inoculation group) or Tetris (gamified control group)
judge.reason: O achado extraído generaliza a estabilidade do efeito de inoculação para os três experimentos, enquanto o resumo indica que houve decaimento significativo no Experimento 2.

items.title: Winning the game against fake news? Using games to inoculate adolescents and young adults in Singapore against fake news

judge.evidence_topic: Guiado por la teoría de la inoculación y estudios que examinaron los juegos serios como una forma de intervención para vacunar a las personas contra las noticias falsas, este estudio probó el impacto en estudiantes universitarios (n = 84) y de secundaria y preparatoria (n = 30) de una noticia falsa. juego de computadora desarrollado en Singapur.
judge.evidence_empirical: este estudio probó el impacto en estudiantes universitarios (n = 84) y de secundaria y preparatoria (n = 30) de una noticia falsa. juego de computadora desarrollado en Singapur.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico experimental com um jogo de computador sobre desinformação, sem abordar os temas excluídos (COVID, vacinas, eleições). O método e os achados extraídos estão alinhados com o resumo.

items.title: Feedback exercises boost discernment of misinformation for gamified inoculation interventions

judge.evidence_topic: Gamification is a promising approach to reducing misinformation susceptibility. Previous research has found that 'inoculation' games such as Bad News and Harmony Square help build cognitive resistance against misinformation.
judge.evidence_empirical: We address these issues in two preregistered lab experiments (N1 = 191, N2 = 321) and four quasi-experimental in-game surveys implemented in Harmony Square (N3 = 559) and Bad News (N4 = 2,558, N5 = 419, N6 = 882).
judge.reason: O artigo aborda jogos de inoculação (Bad News e Harmony Square) para combater a desinformação, sem tratar de temas excluídos. O estudo é empírico, utilizando experimentos e quase-experimentos, e o achado principal está sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Technique-based inoculation against real-world misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: In this study, we address two open questions related to technique-based inoculation in two separate experiments (total n = 2188; convenience sample recruited via the Bad News online game platform)
judge.evidence_empirical: In this study, we address two open questions related to technique-based inoculation in two separate experiments (total n = 2188; convenience sample recruited via the Bad News online game platform)
judge.reason: O artigo utiliza o jogo Bad News para testar a inoculação contra desinformação, realizando dois experimentos empíricos. Não há menção aos temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições ou política partidária) no resumo.

items.title: Good News about Bad News: Gamified Inoculation Boosts Confidence and Cognitive Immunity Against Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: A recent example is the Bad News game, an online fake news game in which players learn about six common misinformation techniques.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using a 2 (treatment vs. control) × 2 (pre vs. post) mixed design (N = 196) we measure participants’ ability to spot misinformation techniques in 18 fake headlines before and after playing Bad News.
judge.reason: O artigo investiga o jogo Bad News, que é um jogo de inoculação contra desinformação, sem abordar os temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições ou política partidária). O estudo é empírico, utilizando um delineamento experimental com grupo de controle, e o método e o achado principal extraídos estão corretamente fundamentados no resumo.

items.title: How to “inoculate” against multimodal misinformation: A conceptual replication of Roozenbeek and van der Linden (2020)

judge.evidence_topic: We developed a game called Cat Park , in which players learn about five manipulation techniques (trolling, emotional manipulation, amplification, polarization, and conspiracism), and how misinformation can spread through images.
judge.evidence_empirical: To test the game’s efficacy, we conducted a conceptual replication ( N = 380) of Roozenbeek and van der Linden’s 2020 study about Harmony Square , with the same study design, item set, and hypotheses.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (experimento) sobre um jogo de inoculação (Cat Park) contra desinformação, sem abordar os temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições). Os dados extraídos refletem corretamente o método e os achados descritos no resumo.

items.title: Playing an Augmented Reality Escape Game Promotes Learning About Fake News

judge.evidence_topic: In this study, we focus on Escape Fake , an augmented reality (AR) escape game developed for use in media literacy education.
judge.evidence_empirical: we conducted a field study using a pretest-posttest research design.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (pré-teste/pós-teste) com um jogo educativo (Escape Fake) sobre desinformação, sem abordar os temas excluídos (COVID, vacinas, eleições). Os dados extraídos estão corretos e refletem o resumo.

items.title: Can pre-service teachers learn about fake news by playing an augmented reality escape game?

judge.evidence_topic: The aim of this study is to address this gap by examining whether pre-service teachers can learn about fake news using the augmented reality escape game Escape Fake.
judge.evidence_empirical: To investigate this question, a pre-/post-test design was conducted with 45 pre-service teachers (four males, mean age=22.59 years, standard deviation=1.80).
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (pré/pós-teste) sobre um jogo educativo (Escape Fake) para combater desinformação, sem violar as restrições de tema (não é sobre COVID, vacinas ou política). O achado extraído reflete fielmente os resultados apresentados no resumo.

items.title: Enhancing Information Literacy for Spotting Fake News: A Study on the Efficacy of a Serious Game for M-Learning Across Different Age Groups

judge.evidence_topic: the goal of this research is to propose a serious game design for learning to evaluate sources using the CRAAP test. In the game, players take on the role of librarians who must evaluate news from social media and newspapers, determine whether it is fake or true
judge.evidence_empirical: To evaluate the game, we did a randomized online field study, including quantitative research based on pre-posttests involving 351 participants.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico (estudo de campo randomizado com pré e pós-teste) sobre um jogo educativo para avaliar fontes de informação, o que está alinhado com o pedido. O achado extraído reflete fielmente o que está no resumo.

items.title: Bad News in the civics classroom: How serious gameplay fosters teenagers' ability to discern misinformation techniques

judge.evidence_topic: Although the serious game Bad News has been used to inoculate citizens against misinformation, it has not been formally evaluated in traditional classrooms. We therefore evaluated its impact on 516 upper-secondary Swedish students playing individually, paired, or with the whole class. Results show that students improved their ability to discern manipulation techniques in social media posts.
judge.evidence_empirical: We therefore evaluated its impact on 516 upper-secondary Swedish students playing individually, paired, or with the whole class.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo empírico de intervenção com o jogo Bad News, avaliando a capacidade de discernir técnicas de manipulação, o que está alinhado com o pedido. Não há menção aos temas excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições, política partidária) e o método de intervenção em sala de aula com medidas pré e pós está descrito no resumo e suporta o achado principal.

items.title: Re-examining the bad news game: No evidence of improved discrimination of Indian true and fake news headlines

items.title: Mixed News about the Bad News Game

judge.evidence_topic: Basol et al. (2020) tested the “the Bad News Game” (BNG), an app designed to improve ability to spot false claims on social media.
judge.evidence_empirical: Here, four teams of undergraduate psychology students each attempted an extended replication of Basol et al., using updated versions of the original Bad News game.
judge.reason: O artigo trata do jogo Bad News (inoculação), não aborda os temas excluídos (COVID, vacinas, eleições), é um estudo empírico (replicação com coleta de dados) e o achado principal está integralmente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: The fake news game: actively inoculating against the risk of misinformation

judge.evidence_topic: we developed a ‘fake news game’ in which participants are actively tasked with creating a news article about a strongly politicized issue (the European refugee crisis)

items.title: Chaos creator: Misinformation inoculation in information literacy instruction

judge.evidence_topic: Via a quasi-experimental study, this research explores the effect of prebunking techniques in an IL instruction session on undergraduate students’ ability to recognise misinformation. The prebunking techniques are delivered through a competitive game called Chaos Creator, based on the Bad News game developed by researchers at Cambridge University.
judge.evidence_empirical: Via a quasi-experimental study, this research explores the effect of prebunking techniques in an IL instruction session on undergraduate students’ ability to recognise misinformation.
judge.reason: O artigo descreve um estudo quase-experimental utilizando um jogo (Chaos Creator) para ensinar técnicas de inoculação contra desinformação, o que está alinhado com o pedido. O tema não envolve os tópicos excluídos (COVID-19, vacinas, eleições, política). Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.
